aboutPage.title: Fiha Islam
aboutPage.headline: Crafting Dimension, Spirit, and Sacred Calligraphy onto Canvas
aboutPage.bioLead: Based in Kutubpur, Fatullah, Narayanganj, Fiha Islam is an independent visual fine artist and calligrapher whose studio practice explores the delicate boundary between tactile three-dimensional texture and spiritual tranquility.
aboutPage.bioStory: Every piece created under the Artora banner is a labour of love—built layer upon layer using heavy body acrylics, organic stone-paste textures, 24k liquid gold leaf gilding, and fluid Quranic Arabic calligraphy. Rather than mass-produced prints, Artora is dedicated to pure, singular, 100% handcrafted studio originals designed to transform luxury residences, modern duplexes, and corporate headquarters into serene sanctuaries.
aboutPage.quote: Art is not merely something to hang on a blank wall; it is the atmospheric pulse and spiritual refuge of your living space.
aboutPage.timelineSubtitle: Milestones of Artistic Discovery & Studio Growth

milestones.title: Studio Genesis & Impasto Experiments
milestones.desc: Began private studio exploration in Narayanganj, experimenting with heavy-body acrylic pastes, palette knife sculpting, and mineral pigments.

milestones.title: Sacred Calligraphy & 24k Gold Gilding
milestones.desc: Pioneered a signature style uniting classic Arabic Thuluth/Diwani script with weathered stone textures and radiant liquid gold leaf.

milestones.title: Artora Brand Inception & Nationwide Reach
milestones.desc: Established Artora under FramEmpire, delivering over 300+ custom commissioned canvases to art lovers across all 64 districts in Bangladesh.

milestones.title: Global Collector Presence & Bespoke Art
milestones.desc: Expanding international shipments to North America, UK, and the Middle East with museum-sealed archival packaging and Certificates of Authenticity.

privacyPolicy.title: PRIVACY POLICY & TERMS
privacyPolicy.lead: At Artora by FramEmpire ("we," "our," or "us"), accessible from artora.framempire.com, we deeply respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information, collector details, and transaction security across our Art Studio, Commission Services, and Gallery Platform.
privacyPolicy.disclaimer: If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please refrain from submitting orders, personal contact information, or utilizing our custom commission services.

sec1.title: 01. Information We Collect
sec1.a1: Contact & Delivery Details: Full name, phone/WhatsApp number, shipping address, city/division for order fulfillment.
sec1.a2: Commission Specifications: Interior wall photos, custom dimensions, color preferences, and design vision provided during art consultations.
sec1.a3: Payment Verification: Transaction reference numbers, mobile banking confirmation IDs (bKash/Nagad), or payment status. We never store raw debit/credit card details.
sec1.b1: Device & Network Diagnostics: IP address, device type, browser specifications, and screen resolution to optimize visual rendering.
sec1.b2: Anonymous Analytics: Aggregated interaction patterns, page viewing duration, and catalog browsing to improve our gallery experience.

sec2.title: 02. How We Use Your Information
sec2.item1Desc: To prepare, inspect, package, and safely dispatch your handcrafted canvas artwork to your specified address.
sec2.item2Desc: To connect with you via WhatsApp or phone call to discuss bespoke dimensions, colors, and progress updates.
sec2.item3Desc: To generate official order receipts, Certificate of Authenticity (CoA) records, and courier shipping waybills.
sec2.item4Desc: To assist you with hanging instructions, framing inquiries, maintenance tips, or delivery tracking.

sec3.title: 03. Delivery, Packaging & Courier Governance
sec3.item1Desc: All orders inside Bangladesh are dispatched via trusted courier partners (Steadfast Courier) with end-to-end tracking and direct home delivery across all 64 districts.
sec3.item2Desc: Every stretched canvas is protected with heavy bubble wrap, rigid corner protectors, and moisture-resistant exterior casing to prevent transit damage.
sec3.item3Desc: Worldwide express courier shipments are secured in heavy-duty wooden crate enclosures with archival moisture shielding.

sec4.title: 04. Custom Commissions, Returns & Transit Damage
sec4.item1Desc: Because custom commissioned paintings are individually handcrafted to your bespoke specifications, materials, and sizes, advance booking deposits are non-refundable once the painting process has commenced.
sec4.item2Desc: If an artwork arrives physically damaged due to courier mishandling, notify us within 24 hours of delivery with unboxing photos/video. We will promptly repair, replace, or re-create the artwork at zero additional cost to you.
sec4.item3Desc: For all custom commissions, high-resolution photographs and studio videos of the completed artwork are shared with the collector for final approval prior to packaging and dispatch.

sec5.title: 05. Intellectual Property & Copyright Protection
sec5.item1Desc: All paintings, calligraphy compositions, color schemes, photography, and digital assets published on Artora are the intellectual property of Fiha Islam and FramEmpire.
sec5.item2Desc: Each original artwork is issued a verifiable physical Certificate of Authenticity signed by the artist, prohibiting unauthorized commercial reproduction, duplication, or counterfeiting.

sec6.title: 06. Collector Privacy Rights & Contact
sec6.item1Desc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or contact information to any third-party advertisers. Information is strictly utilized for studio logistics.
sec6.item2Desc: For privacy requests, address modifications, or inquiries, contact our studio team directly at team.framempire@gmail.com or call +880 1723-722019.
